reading_method: Reuses explicit accepted primary readings with identical source HTML/XML, primary note and ledger hashes. Source-only readings retain body unavailability; matching prior visual observations and asset hashes checked. Fresh reading is claimed only for IDs in fresh_primary_read_ids.
current_period_scope_review: Primary reviewed all pinned prior notes and source-date constraints. All targets have 1861–1866 contexts. Prior own notices are not incoming prompts; named later public responses require their own complete sources. Germination, pollination and dormant-seed hypotheses remain qualified, and proposed plant deliveries are not receipts. No 1847–1850 admission or newly counted relationship.
